question: FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup 2022 matches were NOT held in which state?
solution:
The correct answer is **Gujarat**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup 2022 was held in India, showcasing young female talents in football.
 
• Matches were hosted in various states, but **Gujarat** was not among them.
 
• This event provided a significant platform for the participating countries to present their upcoming football stars.
 
• The tournament played a crucial role in promoting women's football globally and especially in India.
 
• It also aimed to inspire more young girls to take up the sport professionally.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup** is an international football competition for female players under the age of 17.
 
• It is organized by **FIFA**, the sport's global governing body.
 
• The tournament aims to foster the development of young female footballers around the world.
 
• It was first held in 2008, and the competition occurs every two years.
 
• The event helps participating nations to develop their youth football programs and provides a pathway for young talents to progress into their national teams and professional clubs.
